feeds.title: The Guyliner
feeds.description: The definitive, yet disaster-laden, gay dating blog. I'm a freelance writer and editor, and one of the things I do is write under the name of The Guyliner - which began on this very blog. I talked to men online and arranged dates with them. Dating stories, relationships, LGBTQ stuff and the terrifying awkwardness of being alive in the 21st century.

feeds.title: B-Gay
feeds.description: B-Gay.com is an exciting place to hook up with other gays and lesbians, and a great place to find gay and lesbian travel, health, and entertainment news.

feeds.title: Gay Dating In A Small Town
feeds.description: Dating poses so many problems you can't even count them on your hands. If you throw in the fact that I'm in a small town, and gay, I might as well start my cat collection now. Naturally, like any good millennial, I thought I would chronicle it forever on the internet with the hope of offering some advice, get some advice, and maybe even having 1 or 2 people one day read this site.

feeds.title: Gaysian Dating
feeds.description: I am an Asian-American in the mid-'30s who immigrated to the US at a young age living in a major metropolitan city in America. I have a strong identity in queer culture as a gay male and have been dating since high school. For the past 20 years, I have collected stories of many dates and sexual encounters I have experienced.

feeds.title: Men's Vows Blog
feeds.description: Men's Vows is a digital lifestyle magazine supporting men who marry. Discover real gay wedding stories and advice, gay engagement ideas & much more.

feeds.title: Cock Tails And Cock Talk » Dating Tales
feeds.description: Anthony Gilét started Cocktails & Cock-talk in 2011 after a string of disastrous dates led him to question the realities of finding love in the gay world; detailing his mishaps and anecdotes from the scene, C&C built-up a loyal London-based following. Since then, C&C has branched out into a go-to gossip and lifestyle blog, read by millions of people a month from all over the world.

feeds.title: UrbanConnections Blog
feeds.description: Gay Speed Dating events for gay and bi men of all colors, backgrounds, and professions in London. Our mission is to provide a fun, quality experience that connects our diverse community, regardless of color, age or profession.
